name: Zylo API
description: Zylo Basic provides daily access to selected models without a card.
overview: The free Basic plan lists 200,000 daily tokens, 7,200 daily requests and 10 requests per minute for Basic-tier models. The model catalog also displays paid-plan token prices, which do not represent charges under the free Basic allowance. Premium models and prepaid usage are paid.
free_access: No card or credits required for Basic
Paid plans and prepaid usage cost extra
notes: Use gpt-oss at https://api.zyloai.net/v1 on the Basic plan.
